name: wSRX warp route (Sentrix Testnet <-> Sepolia)

knownIssue.summary: HypNative.transferRemote on Sentrix Testnet reverts at 27k gas on broadcast, while eth_estimateGas returns ~116k and eth_call returns a valid messageId.
knownIssue.suspectedCause: Sentrix EVM has a broadcast vs simulation state divergence — possibly related to revm 37 internal handling of `payable` + delegate-style internal calls (TokenRouter -> _transferRemote -> mailbox.dispatch).
knownIssue.workaround: Bridge is functional at the Mailbox dispatch layer (proven via raw Mailbox.dispatch + manual relay in earlier commit). Token wrapper layer needs deeper debugging.
knownIssue.deferTo: Step 4 — investigation will compare HypNative call trace against a working chain (e.g. local anvil fork) to isolate the Sentrix-specific behaviour.

whatWorks: Same-chain Hyperlane message round-trip on Sentrix Testnet (Mailbox.dispatch -> process -> TestRecipient.handle)
Cross-chain Sentrix Testnet -> Sepolia message delivery via Mailbox.dispatch + manual relay
HypNative + HypERC20 contracts deployed + initialized + cross-enrolled. Storage state correct.
PausableHook deployed and wired into HypNative — accepts value, no fee charged.
whatBlocksUsers: transferRemote() reverts on broadcast → users can't actually lock SRX or mint wSRX
Manual workaround via direct Mailbox.dispatch with hand-encoded message body would work but is not user-friendly
No automated validator + relayer agents (current relay is manual via cast send)
